content.short: Active traders use Ourbit for early memecoin listings and zero-fee spot trading, plus futures, tokenized stocks and forex.
content.description: Ourbit calls itself a SuperCEX for degens. It lists memecoins early, works closely with communities like SPX6900, and charges no fees on spot and selected perpetual pairs. Beyond crypto, users can trade tokenized shares, funds, commodities and currency pairs at any hour. It publishes proof of reserves and keeps most funds in offline cold storage. The exchange lists more than 800 crypto assets and 90-plus global markets, and runs Super IPOs for new launches. It reports over a million users in more than a hundred countries.
